scripts.dev: concurrently "cd pocketbase && .\pocketbase.exe serve" "cd api && npm run dev" "cd web && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd web && npm install && npx vite build --outDir www
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --raw "npm run start --prefix api" "npm run start --prefix pocketbase"
scripts.lint: concurrently --raw "npm run lint --prefix web" "npm run lint --prefix api"
